notes: Original published article is available and was read in the supplied canonical text; PDF page 5 (printed p. 253) was rendered and visually inspected. Title and authors in supplied text match the reference. The supplied locator is only p. 5, study 1, and a description covering both implicit and explicit generalization. This page contains multiple eligible tests: immediate implicit preference for new people; immediate original-versus-new implicit attitudes; delayed explicit and implicit preferences for original people; delayed explicit preference for new people; delayed original-versus-new explicit attitudes; delayed implicit preference for new people; delayed original-versus-new implicit attitudes; and change in implicit-explicit correlations. No supplied identifier selects uniquely among these outcomes, sessions, contrasts and analytic samples. Therefore no single effect or analytic n is assigned. The overall completed-materials count in Methods is not established as the analytic sample for an identified target test. The page reports p_rep, not conventional null-hypothesis p; these quantities must not be silently relabelled or converted. Visual inspection also shows that canonical text renders equals signs as 5 and omits some printed minus signs, including those in the immediate and delayed original-versus-new implicit contrasts. No numeric transcription is selected from these ambiguous candidate tests. Source version retained: published article, pp. 249–254; no manuscript or appendix substituted. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders, not acquisition failures.
